title: Three-Project Solution Scaffold + IKeychainProvider
keyDecisionsMade: Used OperatingSystem.IsMacOS()/IsWindows()/IsLinux() instead of RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform() in KeychainProviderFactory.Create() and EncryptedFileKeychainProvider — the Roslyn CA1416 analyzer only recognises OperatingSystem.IsXxx() as valid platform guards, not RuntimeInformation.
Added [SupportedOSPlatform] attributes to the TryCreateMacOs, TryCreateWindows, TryCreateLinux, and GetWindowsMachineGuid helper methods to satisfy CA1416 with TreatWarningsAsErrors=true.
Created DependencyInjectionRegistrar.cs in CliqCli project to bridge Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection with Spectre.Console.Cli's ITypeRegistrar — required for DI to work with the command app.
Used dotnet new sln --format sln to create the .sln file (not .slnx) as .NET 10 defaults to .slnx but the story specifies .sln.
EncryptedFileKeychainProvider key derivation: SHA-256(MachineName + MachineGuid + 'cliq-cli') per OQ-002 default.
EncryptedFileKeychainProvider file layout: [12-byte IV][ciphertext][16-byte GCM tag], stored at <configDir>/keystore/<sanitized-key>.bin where ':' is replaced with '_'.
LinuxKeychainProvider uses TryCreate() factory pattern — catches DllNotFoundException on libsecret-1.so.0 load failure, performs a sentinel probe lookup on init, returns false to activate fallback.
CliqCli.Core.csproj references Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection 10.0.0 — packages at version 10 are available with .NET 10 SDK 10.0.105.

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: Followed default assumption: SHA256(MachineName + MachineGuid + 'cliq-cli'). MachineGuid obtained via ioreg on macOS, Windows Registry on Windows, /etc/machine-id on Linux. IV stored as first 12 bytes of .bin file, ciphertext + 16-byte tag follow.

Followed default assumption: libsecret-1 via P/Invoke with fixed 2-attribute schema (application=cliq-cli, key=<keystring>). TryCreate() catches DllNotFoundException and init probe errors; returns false to trigger EncryptedFileKeychainProvider fallback. CallingConvention.Cdecl used for variadic P/Invoke signatures.

issuesEncountered.issue: CA1416 platform compatibility errors with TreatWarningsAsErrors=true: RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform() is not recognised as a platform guard by the Roslyn analyzer.
issuesEncountered.resolution: Replaced all RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform() calls with OperatingSystem.IsMacOS(), OperatingSystem.IsWindows(), OperatingSystem.IsLinux(). Added [SupportedOSPlatform] attributes to the platform-specific helper methods.

issuesEncountered.issue: dotnet new sln in .NET 10 creates .slnx by default, not .sln.
issuesEncountered.resolution: Used dotnet new sln --format sln flag to force the legacy .sln format as specified in the story.

issuesEncountered.issue: Unused using directives (System.Runtime.InteropServices, System.Text.Json) in EncryptedFileKeychainProvider would cause warnings with TreatWarningsAsErrors.

title: Output Contract + Error Infrastructure + Global Settings
keyDecisionsMade: ErrorEnvelope uses [JsonPropertyName("exitCode")] to override SnakeCaseLower naming policy — the output contract requires camelCase 'exitCode', not 'exit_code'.
OutputJsonOptions and ErrorEnvelope are defined as internal types in JsonOutputWriter.cs; InMemoryOutputWriter reuses them since both are in the same CliqCli.Core assembly.
InMemoryOutputWriter is placed in CliqCli.Core (not in the test project) so all future test stories can inject it without coupling.

--version is intercepted in Main() before the CommandApp because Spectre.Console.Cli's CommandApp does not add --version automatically without a root command type. Outputs AssemblyInformationalVersion.
Ctrl+C (OperationCanceledException) returns exit code 1 with no output in the exception handler.
Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console configured with LogToStandardErrorThreshold = LogLevel.Trace so all Warning+ logs go to stderr only.
INTERNAL_ERROR added to ErrorCodes for unhandled generic exceptions in the global exception handler.

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: WriteError accepts optional 'detail' parameter. ErrorEnvelope includes 'detail' with DefaultIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull so it is only emitted when non-null. Used for API_ERROR only.

issuesEncountered.issue: Spectre.Console.Cli's CommandApp does not add --version automatically without a root command type.
issuesEncountered.resolution: Intercept args is ["--version"] at the top of Main() before the CommandApp, print AssemblyInformationalVersion, return 0.

title: AccountStore + PatAuthProvider + ZohoCorp Block
keyDecisionsMade: IAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync includes optional string? email parameter so PatAuthProvider can apply ZohoCorp block — email is not in the base ADR-0005 interface definition but is needed for the block to be enforced at the auth layer.
AccountStore has an internal constructor accepting configDir for testability. InternalsVisibleTo('CliqCli.Tests') added to CliqCli.Core.csproj via AssemblyAttribute item group.
ZohoCorpGuard is internal static in CliqCli.Core namespace — satisfies ADR-0006 sealed/non-overridable requirement. AssertNotZohoCorp(null) is a no-op.
AccountStore.GetDefaultAsync returns the first account marked IsDefault, falling back to the first account in the list if none is marked. If the list is empty it throws NO_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT.
AccountStore.ApplyWindowsAcl method annotated [SupportedOSPlatform('windows')] and called inside if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows()) — satisfies CA1416 without pragma suppression.
TokenType property in AccountEntry serializes as 'token_type' (not 'token') — the no-token test was updated to check for '"token":' exact property key rather than the substring 'token'.

openQuestionsResolved.resolution: Used FileSecurity + SetAccessRule with current user WindowsIdentity to restrict NTFS ACL. Wrapped in try/catch with ILogger<AccountStore> warning on failure per default assumption.
ZohoCorp check applied in PatAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync and will be applied in ApiClient (Story 5). Scope commands will check in the command layer (Story 5+).

issuesEncountered.issue: AccountStore internal constructor not visible to test project.
issuesEncountered.resolution: Added InternalsVisibleTo('CliqCli.Tests') via AssemblyAttribute in CliqCli.Core.csproj.
Changed assertion to check for '"token":' exact property key, confirming only the designated token_type field is present.
